title: Using spectral flow cytometry to characterize anti-tumor immunity in mouse models of cancer
author: Valenzano, Russell, et al.
materials: Culture medium (see recipe in Reagents and Solutions)
Matrigel Basement Membrane Matrix (Corning, cat. no. 356231)
Dulbecco A Phosphate Buffered Saline, DPBS (Gibco, cat. no. 14190144)
Isoflurane (IsoFlo 100% w/w Inhalation Vapour, liquid, Zoetis, cat. no. 30135687, or equivalent)
Female C57BL/6J mice 7-8 weeks of age
Meloxicam (Metacam 2 mg/ml, Boheringer Ingelheim, cat. no. 30324941, or equivalent)
Keep cells on ice until completion of surgery.
Euthanize the animal by an approved method.

7.Transfer tumor and liver separately onto a Petri dish and mince with scissors until the tissue is finely chopped into pieces less than 1 mm in size. Continue mincing until the tissue resembles a homogenous slurry, with no discernible individual pieces.8.Transfer the slurry into a 15 ml tube with 5 ml of digestion cocktail.9.Incubate in the thermomixer at 37°C, with continuous shaking at 600 rpm, for 30 min (tumor) or 10 min (liver).10.Stop enzymatic digestion by transferring the content of each 15 ml tubes into a 50-ml tube filled with 35 ml of ice-cold R10.11.Elute the contents of the 50-ml tube through a 70-μm and a 40-μm cell strainer, sequentially.12.Press the remaining tissue through the strainer using the back of a 5-ml syringe plunger.13.Add 10 ml of R10 to aid elution.14.Centrifuge at 350 x g for 5 min.15.Label an empty 15-ml tube for each sample and add 5 ml of Ficoll.

steps.title: Thaw and expand KPC‑F cells
steps.instruction: Thaw one vial of KPC‑F at least 1 week before surgery, culture in complete medium at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂, passage as needed and grow to ≈80 % confluency on the day of surgery.

steps.title: Thaw Matrigel on ice
steps.instruction: Place Matrigel vial on ice (or 4 °C) and let thaw overnight (≈12 h) before the surgery day.

steps.title: Prepare ice‑cold reagents
steps.instruction: In a biosafety cabinet wipe the polystyrene box containing Matrigel and ice with ethanol, set it inside the hood, then transfer a clean pipette tip into a sterile 1.5 ml microcentrifuge tube and add the required volume of DPBS to a second sterile 1.5 ml tube; keep both tubes on ice to chill.

steps.title: Harvest and count KPC‑F cells
steps.instruction: Lift adherent KPC‑F cells, mix 10 µl cell suspension with 10 µl trypan blue, load onto a hemocytometer and count under a light microscope.

steps.title: Centrifuge and resuspend cells
steps.instruction: Spin the cells at 350 × g for 5 min, discard supernatant and resuspend the pellet at 5 × 10⁵ cells ml⁻¹ in culture medium.

steps.title: Prepare Matrigel‑DPBS mixture
steps.instruction: Using a pre‑chilled pipette tip, transfer the thawed Matrigel into a clean 1.5 ml tube, add the pre‑chilled DPBS, pipette up‑and‑down gently, avoid touching the vial walls, and keep the tube on ice.

steps.title: Combine cells with Matrigel
steps.instruction: Add the resuspended KPC‑F cells to the Matrigel‑DPBS mixture and mix gently. For 50 mice (20 µl injection each) combine 500 µl Matrigel, 450 µl DPBS and 50 µl cell suspension (final volume 20 µl per mouse).

steps.title: Keep cell suspension on ice
steps.instruction: Maintain the cell‑Matrigel suspension on ice until the surgery is completed.

steps.title: Prepare anesthesia and analgesia
steps.instruction: Fill all anesthetic vaporizers with isoflurane, top up if needed; weigh each mouse; prepare analgesics (e.g., meloxicam 5 mg kg⁻¹ and buprenorphine 0.1 mg kg⁻¹) and set aside; switch on heat pads for induction, preparation, surgical and recovery areas and set temperature to 37 °C; arrange sterile drapes, surgical tools, autoclip applier, cotton swabs, skin disinfectant applicators, sutures, gauzes and insulin syringes on the operating table (packages remain unopened until the surgeon is scrubbed in).

steps.title: Induce anesthesia and pre‑operative care
steps.instruction: Clip fur from the upper left abdomen; turn on anesthetic machines for induction, preparation and surgery; induce anesthesia in the induction chamber with 5 % isoflurane (maintain 2–3 %); move mouse to preparation area, keep anesthesia with a nose cone, inject pre‑operative analgesia subcutaneously using a 1‑ml syringe with a 25 G needle; apply eye‑lubricating ointment; place mouse supine and confirm depth of anesthesia by loss of pedal withdrawal reflex.

steps.title: Perform orthotopic tumor injection
steps.instruction: Disinfect skin, place a sterile drape window over the animal, make a single vertical skin incision <1 cm in the upper left abdomen, blunt‑dissect to expose the abdominal wall, make a second vertical incision ≈0.5 cm through muscle and peritoneum, exteriorize the pancreas (spleen follows) with Debakey forceps and lay flat on gauze; using an insulin syringe, draw 20 µl of the prepared cell suspension (assistant opens and flicks the vial to homogenise), inject into the tail of the pancreas (bleb formation confirms correct injection); pause 30 s for Matrigel solidification, gently return pancreas (and spleen) to the cavity, suture the muscular layer with interrupted sutures, close skin with a clip applicator (1 clip for small incisions, 2 clips for larger).

steps.title: Post‑operative monitoring
steps.instruction: Transfer mouse to the recovery area, monitor until normal activity resumes, provide medicated jelly (after an initial day of non‑medicated jelly for acclimation), remove skin clips on day 5 post‑surgery, and proceed to tissue collection (Basic Protocol 2) at the study endpoint or when tumor volume is sufficient for flow cytometry.

steps.title: Label collection tubes
steps.instruction: For each mouse label three 3‑ml Bijou containers as “Tumor”, “Liver”, “Spleen” and one K2EDTA micro‑tainer as “Blood”. Add 4 ml plain RPMI to each Bijou tube. Pre‑coat a 1‑ml reduced‑dead‑space syringe with 100 µl 0.5 M EDTA and load a 27 G needle (the needle is also coated).

steps.title: Euthanize and collect blood
steps.instruction: Euthanize the mouse by an approved method, perform cardiac puncture with the pre‑coated syringe, transfer blood into the labeled K2EDTA tube and keep at room temperature.

steps.title: Harvest organs on ice
steps.instruction: Using sterile scissors and scalpel, excise tumor, spleen and liver, place each organ into its respective pre‑labeled tube and keep on ice; carefully separate tumor from spleen to avoid splenocyte contamination.

steps.title: Digest tumor tissue
steps.instruction: Transfer tumor to a petri dish, mince with scissors to pieces <1 mm, add to a 15 ml tube containing 5 ml digestion cocktail, incubate in a thermomixer at 37 °C, 600 rpm for 30 min; stop digestion by transferring the slurry to a 50‑ml tube containing 35 ml ice‑cold R10.

steps.title: Digest liver tissue
steps.instruction: Process liver identically but incubate for 10 min at 37 °C, 600 rpm.

steps.title: Strain and wash digests
steps.instruction: Pass each organ slurry sequentially through a 70‑µm then a 40‑µm cell strainer, press remaining tissue through the strainer with the back of a 5‑ml syringe plunger, add 10 ml R10 to aid elution, then centrifuge at 350 × g for 5 min.

steps.title: Prepare Ficoll density gradient
steps.instruction: Label an empty 15‑ml tube, add 5 ml Ficoll; discard supernatant from the previous spin, resuspend the cell pellet in up to 7 ml DPBS, slowly overlay the DPBS‑cell suspension onto the Ficoll without mixing (use lowest pipette speed, dispense dropwise, tilt tube), then centrifuge at 400 × g for 30 min at room temperature with acceleration and deceleration set to 0.

steps.title: Collect low‑density leukocytes
steps.instruction: After centrifugation, collect the thin low‑density cell layer (between plasma and Ficoll) into the pre‑labeled tubes, centrifuge at 350 × g for 5 min, discard supernatant, resuspend in R10.

steps.title: Count and plate cells (tumor/liver)
steps.instruction: Mix 10 µl of the resuspended cells with 10 µl trypan blue, count on a hemocytometer, then seed up to 1 × 10⁶ cells (10⁷ cells ml⁻¹) into two wells of a 96‑well U‑bottom plate; keep on ice until staining.

steps.title: Process spleen tissue
steps.instruction: Mince spleen on a petri dish, transfer to a 15‑ml tube with 10 ml R10, strain through 70‑µm then 40‑µm strainers, press tissue with a 5‑ml syringe plunger, add 10 ml R10, centrifuge 350 × g 5 min, discard supernatant, resuspend in R10, count as above, and seed up to 1 × 10⁶ cells into two wells of a 96‑well U‑bottom plate; keep on ice.

steps.title: Process blood for leukocytes
steps.instruction: Prepare 1X RBC lysis buffer in deionized water; transfer blood from the K2EDTA tube to a 15‑ml tube, rinse the micro‑tainer with 200 µl DPBS and add to the tube; add RBC lysis buffer (10 ml per ml blood), roll continuously for 5 min, top up to 15 ml with R10, centrifuge 350 × g 5 min, discard supernatant, resuspend in R10, count as above, and seed up to 1 × 10⁶ cells into two wells of a 96‑well U‑bottom plate; keep on ice.

steps.title: Centrifuge plates before staining
steps.instruction: Spin the 96‑well U‑bottom plate at 350 × g for 3 min at 4 °C, discard supernatant, resuspend each pellet in 200 µl DPBS, then centrifuge again at 350 × g for 3 min at 4 °C.

steps.title: Viability dye staining
steps.instruction: Discard supernatant, resuspend each cell pellet in 100 µl LIVE/DEAD Blue (pre‑diluted 1:1000 in DPBS) and incubate on ice for 30 min protected from light; for unstained control wells resuspend in 100 µl DPBS.

steps.title: Prepare antibody master mix
steps.instruction: Before or during the 30‑min dye incubation, prepare the surface‑antibody master mix according to the panel, keep the mix at 4 °C protected from light.

steps.title: Optional subcutaneous injection preparation
steps.instruction: For subcutaneous studies, adapt the cell‑Matrigel mixture to 500 µl Matrigel, 450 µl ice‑cold DPBS and 50 µl KPC‑F cells resuspended at 1 × 10⁷ cells ml⁻¹ (final injection volume 100 µl, 50 000 cells per mouse, 10 mice). Follow the same injection steps but place the mouse prone and inject into the flank subcutaneously.
